text: Cascade Ridge Outfitters runs Salesforce for about 150 users, but warranty claims on defective gear have no real home -- they live in email threads and a shared spreadsheet.
Claims go missing between inboxes and age past any reasonable SLA, and nobody notices until a customer calls back angry.
Marisol Fontaine, VP of Customer Service, sponsors this project -- she wants claims actually tracked, owned, and resolved on time.
Two Service regions already exist, West and East, but nothing in Salesforce reflects that for warranty work today.
Next: turning 'fix warranty claims' into one precise, testable requirement.
